fields.summary_ko.0: Berkshire Hathaway (BRKA, BRKB) stock price has risen near all-time highs following Warren Buffett's scheduled retirement at year-end 2025, with new CEO Greg Abel maintaining the company's fundamental character.
fields.summary_ko.1: As of end of Q2, a solid financial position with over $35B in cash and short-term investments, and a diversified business portfolio spanning insurance, utilities, and energy provides appeal as a safe-haven asset during economic slowdown.
